acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The Orbitrap Elite was operated in a data-dependent mode using Xcalibur v3.0.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The samples were alkylated by adding 1 µL 500 mM iodoacetamide to each 50 µL sample for a final concentration of 15 mM and incubating them in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The samples were alkylated by adding 1 µL 500 mM iodoacetamide to each 50 µL sample for a final concentration of 15 mM and incubating them in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes.

cleavage_agent.evidence: A 0.2 µg/µL Trypsin/Lys-C stock solution in Resuspension Buffer was subsequently added to each sample at a 1:50 trypsin/Lys-C:sample ratio by mass to digest the protein into tryptic peptides.
The samples were mixed and then shaken at 500 rpm for 4 hours in a thermocycler at 37 °C for the initial digestion by Lys-C.
Afterwards, each sample was diluted sixfold by adding 250 µL 50 mM NH4HCO3 to reduce the urea concentration to 1 M to allow trypsin to refold.

collision_energy.evidence: The isolation width was 1.8 m/z, the normalized collision energy was 35%, and the activation time was 10 milliseconds.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Collision-induced dissociation (CID) MS/MS scans were recorded after each MS1 scan (R = 120,000) for the top 15 most abundant precursor ions in the Orbitrap.

instrument.evidence: Mass spectrometry was performed on an Acquity UPLC (ultra performance liquid chromatography) M-class system coupled online to an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The UPLC solvents A and B were 0.1% (v/v) formic acid and 0.1% formic acid (v/v) in/100% acetonitrile, respectively.

labeling.evidence: inferred: We have developed a label-free methodology called RAPIDASH to enrich ribosomes and RAPs from any sample.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Mass spectrometry was performed on an Acquity UPLC (ultra performance liquid chromatography) M-class system coupled online to an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer.
